description: This file implements the 'List' feature for articles in a Conduit-based application. It defines a request handler class that processes article listing queries with optional filters such as tag, author, favorited username, feed (following), limit, and offset. The handler interacts with Entity Framework Core to query the database and constructs an articles envelope with the resulting articles and total count.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Contains the request class 'Query' and the request handler class for listing articles based on various filters.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the article listing request asynchronously, applies filters, and returns an envelope with articles and total count.
